notes:
- Account: mid-market CCaaS vendor providing contact center orchestration to retailers.
- Primary champion: Priya Narang (CTO) focused on agent productivity metrics (AHT down, CSAT).
- Primary pain: agent latency and noisy suggestions during spikes; need streaming suggestions that don't block UI.
- Product ask: real-time agent assist with tooling calls (e.g., ticket create, order lookup), live suggestion streaming, and deterministic guardrails (red-teaming + regex/blocklists).
- Latency targets: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 250ms for single-turn suggestion; sla for synchronous tool-calls must be <500ms end-to-end.
- Throughput: average 350 concurrent agents during business hours, 1.5k peak during promotions; expect bursts 3-4x for 4 hours during campaigns.
- Model preference: prefer quantized Llama 2/Redwood-verified open models for on-prem/Dedicated. Interested in fallback to smaller fast model for latency-critical requests.
- Observability: token-level cost/latency breakdowns required; need per-route tracing for RCA.
- Guardrails & safety: require deterministic output sanitizers, taxonomy-based suppression for PII, and ability to turn off suggestions per-queue.
- Integration notes: Genesys Cloud is primary call-router; Zendesk for ticket back-end; need webhook/toolcall adapter.
- Quote from Priya: 'If suggestions are even a hair slow, agents ignore them — so throughput and tail latency win over model size for us.'
concise_summary: Evaluating Redwood Dedicated for real-time agent-assist POC. Needs low tail latency streaming suggestions, reliable behavior during marketing spikes, tool-calling integrations with Genesys/Zendesk, and strict data residency + audit controls. Legal and cost sensitivity are primary blockers.
demo_feedback:
- Agents liked concise summaries and auto-fill snippets.
- Issues: occasional hallucination on order lookups — SE suggests strict tool-call canonicalization and prompt templates.
- Performance: median latency good; p95 needs tuning (batching + prefix caching recommended).
purchase_timeline_notes: Procurement target: finalize Dedicated contract + residency addendum by May 2026. Legal review window 3-4 weeks post SOC2 docs.
